hit_proof.liveness: Real mdb_get is counted, DBI must be adjacency metadata and key exactly type 7 + 8-byte ID. Any native cursor method fails. Each nonsentinel candidate must cause exactly one read, independent of PO budget; all four positions, duplicate logical writes, cross-plane/cross-row reference multiplicity, rollback and final deletion are asserted.
hit_proof.snapshot: A real SailDataset is materialized and prefix/root plans captured before a distinct statement commit. Exact RDF revision +1, old 50/new 51, absent/present new subject, disjoint root partitions, prefix counts, supported orders and parallel-source admission are asserted.
hit_proof.preferences: Every one of 24 preferences reopens the same nonempty explicit/inferred store. Exact native DB names and raw pages/metadata/deltas maps must remain unchanged; RDF revision begins at zero with no mutation. Namespace-native commits are allowed across constructors; only repeated compatibility scheduling must not invent a native commit. Exact independent unsigned-ordered rows and both-direction/count/reference helper are checked.
hit_proof.corruption: Actual native format value overwritten with 3 or 8192 bytes, normal constructor must throw. Entire nonvolatile directory snapshot must remain unchanged (shared fixture excludes lock and lock.mdb); actual valid bytes restored, full raw authority and both-plane model required on fresh reopen.
